# DeltaLeaf SST

## Conversion chain

DeltaLeaf converts a 13.8 kV AC feeder to an 800 V DC bus at 1.2 MW.

The input stage uses cascaded H-bridge cells, and the isolation stage uses dual-active-bridge modules.

## Performance

The measured full-load efficiency is 98.7% with a 45 °C coolant inlet.
